test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 11 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.**

In spite of many ________ we managed to go ahead with our tree plantation drive.
solution: The correct answer is 'restrictions' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate word for the given blank is **'restrictions'.** • It means the **action of limiting **the freedom of somebody/something. • **Example: ***There are parking **restrictions **in the town.__* • ​Therefore, as per the point mentioned above, we find that the correct answer is**option 2. ** **​** The correct sentence will be:*​"__In spite of many **restrictions,** we managed to go ahead with our tree plantation drive__".* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__ __ • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • confirmation: An act of ensuring the truth • affirmation: A statement or sign that something is true. • moment: A very short period of time. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__** __ • ​दिए गए रिक्त स्थान के लिए सबसे उपयुक्त शब्द **'restrictions' **है I • ​इसका अर्थ है किसी की स्वतंत्रता को सीमित करने की क्रिया। • **उदाहरण: **There are parking restrictions in the town.__ • इसलिए, ऊपर बताए गए बिंदु के अनुसार, हम पाते हैं कि सही विकल्प 2 उत्तर है I **इसलिए सही वाक्य होगा:** "__In spite of many restrictions, we managed to go ahead with our tree plantation drive__*".* • आइए दूसरे शब्दों के अर्थ को देखें: • confirmation: सच्चाई सुनिश्चित करने का एक कार्य। • affirmation: एक बयान या संकेत है कि कुछ सच है। • moment: बहुत ही कम समय की अवधि। 48:T18b2, The correct answer is **"****gathered at".**
